name: context-menu
title: Animated Context Menu
description: Open a menu at a pointer position with checkbox, radio and submenu compositions.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Check } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { useMotionState } from "../../state";
import ContextMenuItemBase from "./ContextMenuItemBase.vue";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue?: boolean; checked?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; closeOnSelect?: boolean;
  tone?: "default" | "destructive"; inset?: boolean; textValue?: string;
}>(), { modelValue: undefined, checked: undefined, closeOnSelect: true });
const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "update:checked", "change"]);
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
const checked = useMotionState(props, emit, "modelValue", props.checked ?? false);
function select() { const next = !checked.value; checked.value = next; emit("update:checked", checked.value); }
</script>
<template>
  <ContextMenuItemBase
    v-bind="{ disabled, closeOnSelect, tone, inset, textValue }"
    role="menuitemcheckbox"
    :aria-checked="checked"
    @select="select"
    ><span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center"
      ><Check v-if="checked" class="size-3.5" /></span
    ><slot
  /></ContextMenuItemBase>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useMenu } from "./menu-state";
import { useMenuSurface } from "./menu-surface";
withDefaults(defineProps<{ ariaLabel?: string }>(), { ariaLabel: "Context menu" });
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
const ctx = useMenu();
const { mounted, position, morphReady, collapsed, visualOpen, key } = useMenuSurface(ctx);
</script>
<template>
  <Teleport v-if="mounted" to="body"
    ><div
      data-context-menu-portal
      :aria-hidden="!ctx.open.value"
      :inert="!ctx.open.value"
      :style="{ left: position.x + 'px', top: position.y + 'px' }"
      :class="
        cn(
          'fixed z-[100] [filter:drop-shadow(0_18px_28px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2))]',
          ctx.open.value ? 'pointer-events-auto' : 'pointer-events-none',
        )
      "
    >
      <motion.div
        :ref="(el: unknown) => (ctx.contentRef.value = resolveElement(el))"
        :id="ctx.id"
        role="menu"
        :aria-label="ariaLabel"
        :data-morph-ready="morphReady ? 'true' : 'false'"
        tabindex="-1"
        :initial="false"
        :animate="{
          opacity: visualOpen ? 1 : 0,
          clipPath:
            ctx.reduce.value || ctx.modality.value === 'keyboard' || visualOpen
              ? 'inset(0px 0px 0px 0px round 12px)'
              : collapsed,
        }"
        :transition="
          ctx.modality.value === 'keyboard'
            ? { duration: 0 }
            : ctx.reduce.value
              ? { duration: 0.1, ease: EASE_OUT }
              : {
                  clipPath: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE_OUT },
                  opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE_OUT },
                }
        "
        @keydown="key"
        @contextmenu.prevent
        :class="
          cn(
            'min-w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-1.5 text-foreground outline-none',
            $attrs.class,
          )
        "
        ><slot
      /></motion.div></div
  ></Teleport>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ContextMenuItemBase from "./ContextMenuItemBase.vue";
withDefaults(defineProps<{ disabled?: boolean; closeOnSelect?: boolean; tone?: "default" | "destructive"; inset?: boolean; textValue?: string }>(), { closeOnSelect: true });
const emit = defineEmits(["select"]);
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
</script>
<template>
  <ContextMenuItemBase v-bind="$props" @select="emit('select')"
    ><slot
  /></ContextMenuItemBase>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useId } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useMenu } from "./menu-state";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  disabled?: boolean; closeOnSelect?: boolean; tone?: "default" | "destructive";
  inset?: boolean; textValue?: string; role?: "menuitem" | "menuitemcheckbox" | "menuitemradio"; ariaChecked?: boolean;
}>(), { closeOnSelect: true, tone: "default", role: "menuitem" });
const emit = defineEmits(["select"]);
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
const ctx = useMenu(), id = useId();
function click() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  emit("select");
  if (props.closeOnSelect) ctx.setOpen(false);
}
</script>
<template>
  <button
    :id="id"
    type="button"
    :role="role"
    :aria-checked="role === 'menuitem' ? undefined : ariaChecked"
    :disabled="disabled"
    data-context-menu-item="true"
    :data-disabled="disabled ? 'true' : undefined"
    :data-label="textValue"
    tabindex="-1"
    @focus="ctx.activeId.value = id"
    @pointermove="
      (e) => {
        if (!disabled && e.pointerType !== 'touch')
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).focus();
      }
    "
    @click="click"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative isolate flex w-full select-none items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-[13px] outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40',
        inset && 'pl-8',
        tone === 'destructive' ? 'text-destructive' : 'text-foreground',
      )
    "
  >
    <motion.span
      v-if="ctx.activeId.value === id"
      :layout-id="ctx.id + '-active'"
      :class="
        cn(
          'absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-lg',
          tone === 'destructive'
            ? 'bg-destructive/10'
            : 'bg-foreground/[0.065]',
        )
      "
      :transition="ctx.reduce.value ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT"
    /><slot />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, type Ref } from "vue";
import { Circle } from "lucide-vue-next";
import ContextMenuItemBase from "./ContextMenuItemBase.vue";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ value: string; disabled?: boolean; closeOnSelect?: boolean; tone?: "default" | "destructive"; inset?: boolean; textValue?: string }>(), { closeOnSelect: true });
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
const group = inject<Ref<string>>("orvui-context-radio");
if (!group) throw new Error("A context radio item requires ContextMenuRadioGroup");
const selected = computed(() => group.value === props.value);
const select = () => { group.value = props.value; };
</script>
<template>
  <ContextMenuItemBase
    v-bind="{ disabled, closeOnSelect, tone, inset, textValue }"
    role="menuitemradio"
    :aria-checked="selected"
    @select="select"
    ><span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center"
      ><Circle v-if="selected" class="size-1.5 fill-current" /></span
    ><slot
  /></ContextMenuItemBase>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const attrs = useAttrs();
const separatorGeometry = ["-mx-1", "my-1", "h-px", "border-0", "bg-border"];
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h("hr", { ...attrs, class: cn(separatorGeometry, attrs.class) });
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { cloneVNode, defineComponent, h, mergeProps, useAttrs, useSlots } from "vue";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { useMenu } from "./menu-state";
import { useMenuGesture } from "./menu-trigger";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps<{ disabled?: boolean }>();
defineSlots<{ default(): unknown }>();
const ctx = useMenu(), slots = useSlots(), attrs = useAttrs();
const gesture = useMenuGesture(ctx, () => props.disabled);
const Trigger = defineComponent({ setup() { return () => {
  const children = slots.default?.() ?? [];
  const child = children.find(node => typeof node.type !== "symbol");
  const bindings = mergeProps(attrs, gesture, {
    ref: (value: unknown) => { ctx.trigger.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(value); },
    "aria-controls": ctx.open.value ? ctx.id : undefined,
    "aria-expanded": ctx.open.value, "aria-haspopup": "menu", class: "[-webkit-touch-callout:none]",
  });
  return child ? cloneVNode(child, bindings, true) : h("div", { ...bindings, tabindex: 0 }, children);
} } });
</script>
<template><Trigger /></template>
